handoff: Approve: review #1's blocking finding is fixed. machineHomeOf now resolves the norn home, so worktree paths under a symlinked home match the paths git reports, and a new integration test covers it. Unit 1734 pass, typecheck green. Two non-blocking notes.

findings.title: Default decide fixture still reports the old /r-worktrees folder (carried over from review #1, not fixed)
findings.detail:
The shared Facts fixture sets repo.worktrees to '/r-worktrees', the layout this story removes. It does no harm, because decide does not care where paths point, but a reader is misled.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Point it at a folder shaped like the machine dir the next time the fixture is touched.

findings.title: orphanedMachineDirs compares the resolved own machine dir with an unresolved listing
findings.detail:
machineDir(root) is now built on the resolved home, but `repos = machineReposDir(home)` uses the home as given. With a symlinked home, `dir !== own` never excludes the checkout's own dir. The filter that follows (a checkout path that no longer exists) still drops it, so nothing visible goes wrong.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Compare realpaths, or build the listing from the same resolved home.
